This smartphone UI screen is for creating a recipe. The main contents and functions include:

1. **Food name**: A text field to enter the name of the dish.
2. **Food description**: An optional text field to provide a description of the dish.
3. **Prep time**: A field to input the preparation time in minutes.
4. **Cook time**: A field to input the cooking time in minutes.
5. **Recipe yields**: A field to specify the number of servings the recipe makes.
6. **Serving size**: A field to specify the size of each serving.
7. **Category**: A dropdown menu to select the category of the dish (default is "Other").
8. **Dish type**: Options to select whether the dish is a "Side dish" or "Main dish".
